summary: Edition 42’s Tuesday-window selection, draft, triage, and ClaimCheck material hang together: proposed versus merged status is labeled correctly (including the NIP-86 correction of #41’s obsolete method names and the distinct merged invite-code work in #2408), Elisym/Mostro/Wisp/Buzz release-versus-development splits are intentional, Bitcoin-primary skips are justified, and the scheduled Six Years of Nostr Septembers section delivers six chronological September years (2021–2026) with primary-source anchors and 2026 in-window merges rather than substituting a deep dive for month-end history.
